div.div: نُوتِىٌّ [and ↓ نَوَّاتٌ ] A sailor upon the sea, (S, K,) who turns about the ship in the sea: (TA:) pl. of the former نَوَاتِىُّ, (S, K,) [and of the latter] نَوَّاتُونَ. (TA.) Accord. to J, from the language of the people of Syria: accord. to others, an arabicized word [from the Greek nau/ths]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
